The [Projectile|Projectiles] cannot [Hit] the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that [Consume|Consume] [ArmourBreak|Broken Armour].

stats: [Remnant|Remnants] created by Supported Skills last for 8 seconds
Supported Skills [StatGain|Gain] 20% of Life and Mana Cost as [StatGain|Extra] [Ward|Runic Ward] Cost

Scouring Flame.d: Supports any skill that [Hit|Hits] enemies, causing inflicted [Ignite|Ignites] to deal more damage but the skill to gain a [Ward|Runic Ward] cost.

stats: Supported Skills [StatGain|Gain] 25% of Life and Mana Cost as [StatGain|Extra] [Ward|Runic Ward] Cost
50% more [BuffMagnitude|Magnitude] of [Ignite] inflicted with Supported Skills

Fist Of Kalguur.d: Supports [Slam|Slams] you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of [Ward|Runic Ward] to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted [Slam|Slams] are [Empowered] with extra [Physical] damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an [Aftershock] after a duration. Cannot support [Channelling] Skills.

stats: Supported Skills spend [Ward|Runic Ward] equal to 150% of Life and Mana Cost if possible to become Runically Boosted

Healing Runes.d: Supports [Persistent|Persistent] [Buff|Buff] Skills, causing you to lose [Ward|Runic Ward] and heal nearby allies based on the [Ward] lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

stats: Lose up to 10% of your maximum [Ward|Runic Ward] every 5 seconds to heal nearby allies for a total of 200% of the amount of [Ward] lost

Olroth's Conviction.d: Supports skills that can [Empowered|Empower] a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

stats: Supported Skills [StatGain|Gain] 100% of Life and Mana Cost as [StatGain|Extra] [Ward|Runic Ward] Cost

Olroth's Conviction.fl:
The Empty-Eyed Fiend emerged from darkness.
